evidence: For ZnO, we also used in the gas atmosphere a precursor pair consisting of two compounds (ZnCl2+H2O) as well as a compound and an element (ZnCl2+O2). We used nitrogen as the carrier gas at a few millibars pressure, and carried out typically a few thousands of ALE cycles of about 1s each. The best-quality ZnO ﬁlms were obtained using single chemical exchange reaction and sapphire substrates covered with MOCVD-grown GaN ﬁlms. The synthesis reaction was used to grow a ﬁlm of 1.1mm thickness. The obtained ZnO layers were crystalline and showed very smooth surfaces with monoatomic growth steps on the surfaces.
